FORM ENGINE · DEFINITION PROTOCOL · EXAMPLES

协议定义、结构与变化流程

每个事例按顶层模块横向并列展示完整 FormDefinition：数据、计算、约束、联动、视图与模板各占一张卡片，便于对照它们之间的关系。

每张卡片保留所属模块的全部定义，不省略嵌套内容。横向看模块分工，纵向读模块内部；下方结构与流程提供辅助说明。

  1. 01基础资料
  2. 02订单表达式与联动
  3. 03嵌套成员与模板
  4. 04投保协议基线
  5. 05多层理赔与父级约束
  6. 06多级联动与汇总
  7. 07出行日期、生日与地区规则
  8. 08命令、引用与事件环境
01 · FORM ENGINE

基础资料

最小定义由 Data Schema、Material、Binding 和 Host Event 组成；不需要引入 Scope 或 Reaction。

协议定义 · 结构关系 · 变化流程

完整事例协议 · 按模块并列

01-basic.json · 横向滚动查看所有模块；各卡片保留完整内容，纵向独立滚动。所有卡片的顶层字段合起来就是这份完整 FormDefinition。

打开完整 JSON · 查看输入数据 Fixture · 结构示意 · 流程说明

01

定义信息

protocolVersion, id, version, metadata

{
  "protocolVersion": "1.0",
  "id": "basic-enrollment",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "metadata": {
    "tier": "01",
    "scenario": "基础信息表单",
    "testValue": "仅 Data + Material + Binding"
  }
}
02

Data · 数据定义

data

{
  "data": {
    "schema": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "name",
        "email",
        "age"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1
        },
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "email"
        },
        "age": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 18
        },
        "notes": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
03

Views · 视图入口

views

{
  "views": {
    "default": {
      "material": "stack",
      "slots": {
        "default": [
          {
            "material": "text-input",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/name"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "姓名"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "text-input",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/email"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "邮箱"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "number-input",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/age"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "年龄"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "button",
            "props": {
              "label": "提交"
            },
            "on": {
              "activate": {
                "type": "host.emit",
                "event": "basic.submitRequested"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}

结构关系

树表示定义与引用，不按 Fixture 展开实际组件实例。

Data : object
├─ name : string
├─ email : string
├─ age : integer
└─ notes : string
views.default
Material stack
└─ slots.default
   ├─ Material text-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/name
   ├─ Material text-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/email
   ├─ Material number-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/age
   └─ Material button
      └─ on.activate → host.emit basic.submitRequested

变化流程

Binding 只关联数据位置；on.activate 声明提交意图，实际提交由 Host 负责。

数据变化举证 · 1 个场景

来自有界抽测器的实际输出；步骤顺序不冻结正式 L3 调度算法。

示例：修改绑定字段后查看影响
input
引用位置之前之后
/name"Alice""Lin"
02 · FORM ENGINE

订单表达式与联动

同一份数据分别被表达式读取、被 Reaction 修改、被 Constraint 检查。动态摘要直接引用命名 Expression。

01

定义信息

protocolVersion, id, version, metadata

  "id": "order-live-pricing",

02

Data · 数据定义

data

{
  "data": {
    "schema": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "order"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "order": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "country",
            "quantity",
            "unitPrice",
            "type"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "country": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "city": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ]
            },
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "enum": [
                "standard",
                "premium"
              ]
            },
            "quantity": {
              "type": "integer",
              "minimum": 1
            },
            "unitPrice": {
              "type": "number",
              "minimum": 0
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
03

Constraints · 校验约束

constraints

{
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "positive-quantity",
      "kind": "internal",
      "assert": {
        "op": "gt",
        "args": [
          {
            "ref": {
              "source": "data",
              "path": "/order/quantity"
            }
          },
          0
        ]
      },
      "issue": {
        "target": {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/order/quantity"
        },
        "code": "POSITIVE_QUANTITY"
      }
    }
  ]
}
04

Reactions · 数据联动

reactions

{
  "reactions": [
    {
      "id": "reset-city",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/order/country"
        }
      ],
      "then": [
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/order/city"
          },
          "value": null
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Views · 视图入口

views

{
  "views": {
    "default": {
      "material": "stack",
      "slots": {
        "default": [
          {
            "material": "country-picker",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/order/country"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "国家"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "city-picker",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/order/city"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "城市"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "select",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/order/type"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "商品类型"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "number-input",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/order/quantity"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "购买数量"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "number-input",
            "bindings": {
              "value": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/order/unitPrice"
              }
            },
            "props": {
              "label": "单价"
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "summary-card",
            "props": {
              "title": "订单摘要",
              "total": {
                "$expr": {
                  "use": "orderTotal"

              },
              "badge": {
                "visible": {
                  "$expr": {
                    "op": "eq",
                    "args": [
                      {

                        }
                      },
                      "premium"
                    ]
                  }
                },
                "text": "尊享"
              }
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "button",
            "props": {
              "label": "提交"
            },
            "on": {
              "activate": {
                "type": "host.emit",
                "event": "order.submitRequested"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
06

Expressions · 命名计算

expressions

{
  "expressions": {
    "orderTotal": {
      "op": "mul",
      "args": [
        {
          "ref": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/order/quantity"
          }
        },
        {
          "ref": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/order/unitPrice"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

结构关系

树表示定义与引用，不按 Fixture 展开实际组件实例。

Data : object
└─ order : object
   ├─ country : string
   ├─ city : string | null
   ├─ type : string
   ├─ quantity : integer
   └─ unitPrice : number
views.default
Material stack
└─ slots.default
   ├─ Material country-picker
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/order/country
   ├─ Material city-picker
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/order/city
   ├─ Material select
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/order/type
   ├─ Material number-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/order/quantity
   ├─ Material number-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ data:/order/unitPrice
   ├─ Material summary-card
   └─ Material button
      └─ on.activate → host.emit order.submitRequested

变化流程

orderTotal 是只读计算。reset-city 只 watch country；修改 quantity 影响摘要，但不会清空 city。

数据变化举证 · 1 个场景

来自有界抽测器的实际输出；步骤顺序不冻结正式 L3 调度算法。

示例：修改绑定字段后查看影响
input
  ↓
reset-city
引用位置之前之后
/order/country"Japan""SG"
/order/city"Tokyo"null
03 · FORM ENGINE

嵌套成员与模板

团队与成员建立两层词法绑定；Template 通过 DataReference 参数接收当前成员，校验义务按成员展开。

02

Data · 数据定义

data

{
  "data": {
    "schema": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "teams"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "teams": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Team"
          }
        }
      },
      "$defs": {
        "Team": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "title": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "members": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/Member"
              },
              "minItems": 1
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "title",
            "members"
          ]
        },
        "Member": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "name",
            "age",
            "passport",
            "address"
          ],
          "properties": {
            "name": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "age": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "passport": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "address": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "country": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "city": {
                  "type": [
                    "string",
                    "null"
                  ]
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
03

Constraints · 校验约束

constraints

{
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "member-adult",
      "kind": "internal",
      "assert": {
        "op": "gte",
        "args": [
          {
            "ref": {
              "source": "data",
              "path": "/age",
              "scope": "member"
            }
          },
          18
        ]
      },
      "issue": {
        "target": {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/age",
          "scope": "member"
        },
        "code": "MEMBER_ADULT"
      },
      "scope": [
        {
          "from": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/teams"
          },
          "as": "team",
          "mode": "each"
        },
        {
          "from": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/members",
            "scope": "team"
          },
          "as": "member",
          "mode": "each"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "passport-screen",
      "kind": "external",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/passport",
          "scope": "member"
        },
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/address/country",
          "scope": "member"
        }
      ],
      "target": {
        "source": "data",
        "path": "/passport",
        "scope": "member"
      },
      "requiredForSubmit": true,
      "scope": [
        {
          "from": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/teams"
          },
          "as": "team",
          "mode": "each"
        },
        {
          "from": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/members",
            "scope": "team"
          },
          "as": "member",
          "mode": "each"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Views · 视图入口

views

{
  "views": {
    "default": {
      "material": "stack",
      "slots": {
        "default": [
          {
            "scope": {
              "from": {
                "source": "data",
                "path": "/teams"
              },
              "as": "team",
              "mode": "each"
            },
            "node": {
              "material": "section",
              "props": {
                "title": {
                  "$expr": {
                    "ref": {
                      "source": "data",
                      "path": "/title",
                      "scope": "team"

                  }
                }
              },
              "slots": {
                "default": [
                  {
                    "scope": {
                      "from": {
                        "source": "data",
                        "path": "/members",
                        "scope": "team"
                      },
                      "as": "member",
                      "mode": "each"
                    },
                    "node": {
                      "material": "stack",
                      "slots": {
                        "default": [
                          {
                            "$use": "member-fields",
                            "with": {
                              "member": {
                                "source": "data",
                                "path": "",
                                "scope": "member"
                              }
                            }
                          },
                          {
                            "material": "button",
                            "props": {
                              "label": "移除成员"
                            },
                            "on": {
                              "activate": {
                                "type": "form.command",
                                "command": {
                                  "op": "array.remove",
                                  "target": {
                                    "source": "data",
                                    "path": "/members",
                                    "scope": "team"
                                  },
                                  "item": {
                                    "$scope": "member"
                                  }
                                }
                              }
                            }
                          }
                        ]
                      }
                    }
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          },
          {
            "material": "button",
            "props": {
              "label": "提交"
            },
            "on": {
              "activate": {
                "type": "host.emit",
                "event": "team.submitRequested"
              }
            }
          }
        ]

    }

}

结构关系

树表示定义与引用，不按 Fixture 展开实际组件实例。

Data : object
└─ teams : array
   └─ [] : #/$defs/Team
views.default
Material stack
└─ slots.default
   ├─ Scope each team ← data:/teams
   │  └─ Material section
   │     └─ slots.default
   │        └─ Scope each member ← team:/members
   │           └─ Material stack
   │              └─ slots.default
   │                 ├─ $use member-fields
   │                 │  └─ member ← member:〈根〉
   │                 └─ Material button
   │                    └─ on.activate → form.command
   └─ Material button
      └─ on.activate → host.emit team.submitRequested
viewTemplates.member-fields
Material section
└─ slots.default
   ├─ Material text-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ member:/name
   ├─ Material number-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ member:/age
   ├─ Material text-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ member:/passport
   ├─ Material country-picker
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ member:/address/country
   └─ Material city-picker
      └─ bindings.value ↔ member:/address/city

变化流程

rule.scope 是有序链：先绑定 team，再从 team.members 绑定 member。模板不隐式捕获调用方作用域。

数据变化举证 · 1 个场景

来自有界抽测器的实际输出；步骤顺序不冻结正式 L3 调度算法。

示例：修改绑定字段后查看影响
input
  ↓
member-country-reset
引用位置之前之后
/teams/0/members/1/address/country"SG""US"
/teams/0/members/1/address/city"Singapore"null
04 · FORM ENGINE

投保协议基线

两个 Profile 选择不同 View 入口，复用同一编辑模板、Data 和业务规则；容器呈现不引入新的 Command。

树表示定义与引用，不按 Fixture 展开实际组件实例。

Data : object

├─ insureds : array
│  └─ [] : #/$defs/Insured

$use expanded-form

$use compact-form

Material stack
└─ slots.default

   ├─ Material number-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ insured:/age
   ├─ Material country-picker

viewTemplates.compact-form

└─ slots.default

   │     └─ slots.content

   └─ Material button
      └─ on.activate → host.emit insurance.submitRequested

变化流程

expanded 与 compact 的值直接是 ViewNode，可用 $use 引用静态模板。trigger/content 是容器物料的 Slots，不是 Runtime 的开窗指令。

变化流程

三层作用域为 policy → traveller → claim。跨父级额度与当前理赔项金额参与同一断言，Issue 仍指向当前 claim.amount。

数据变化举证 · 1 个场景

来自有界抽测器的实际输出；步骤顺序不冻结正式 L3 调度算法。

示例：修改绑定字段后查看影响
input
  ↓
reset-incident-city
引用位置之前之后
/policies/0/travellers/0/claims/0/incidentCountry"JP""SG"
/policies/0/travellers/0/claims/0/incidentCity"Tokyo"null
06 · FORM ENGINE

多级联动与汇总

联动分为地址清空链和金额计算链。watch 决定触发，when 仅作执行门控；按项计算与父级汇总通过明确数据引用连接。

协议定义 · 结构关系 · 变化流程

完整事例协议 · 按模块并列

06-cascade-cart.json · 横向滚动查看所有模块；各卡片保留完整内容，纵向独立滚动。所有卡片的顶层字段合起来就是这份完整 FormDefinition。

}

05

Reactions · 数据联动

reactions

{
  "reactions": [
    {
      "id": "country-clears-city",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/country"
        }
      ],
      "then": [
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/cart/city"
          },
          "value": null
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "city-clears-district",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/city"
        }
      ],
      "then": [
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/cart/district"
          },
          "value": null
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "line-subtotal",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/quantity",
          "scope": "line"
        },
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/unitPrice",
          "scope": "line"
        }
      ],
      "then": [
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/subtotal",
            "scope": "line"
          },
          "value": {
            "$expr": {
              "op": "mul",
              "args": [
                {
                  "ref": {
                    "source": "data",
                    "path": "/quantity",
                    "scope": "line"
                  }
                },
                {
                  "ref": {
                    "source": "data",
                    "path": "/unitPrice",
                    "scope": "line"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        }
      ],
      "scope": {
        "from": {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/lines"
        },
        "as": "line",
        "mode": "each"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "aggregate-total",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/lines"
        }
      ],
      "then": [
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/cart/total"
          },
          "value": {
            "$expr": {
              "use": "gross"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "campaign-discount",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/campaign"
        },
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/total"
        }
      ],
      "then": [
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/cart/discount"
          },
          "value": 0
        },
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/cart/discount"
          },
          "value": {
            "$expr": {
              "op": "mul",
              "args": [
                {
                  "ref": {
                    "source": "data",
                    "path": "/cart/total"
                  }
                },
                0.1
              ]
            }
          }
        }
      ],
      "when": {
        "ref": {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/discountEnabled"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "net-payable",
      "watch": [
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/total"
        },
        {
          "source": "data",
          "path": "/cart/discount"
        }
      ],
      "then": [
        {
          "op": "set",
          "target": {
            "source": "data",
            "path": "/cart/payable"
          },
          "value": {
            "$expr": {
              "use": "net"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

结构关系

变化流程

line.quantity / unitPrice → line.subtotal → cart.total → cart.discount → cart.payable。discountEnabled 只在 when 中，单独改变它不会触发规则。

数据变化举证 · 4 个场景

来自有界抽测器的实际输出；步骤顺序不冻结正式 L3 调度算法。

修改第一行数量 2 → 3
input
  ↓
line-subtotal
  ↓
aggregate-total
  ↓
campaign-discount
  ↓
net-payable
引用位置之前之后
/cart/lines/0/subtotal200300
/cart/lines/1/subtotal5050
/cart/total250350
/cart/discount2535.0
/cart/payable225315.0
修改国家 A → B
input
  ↓
country-clears-city
  ↓
city-clears-district
引用位置之前之后
/cart/country"A""B"
/cart/city"CityA"null
/cart/district"DistrictA"null
/cart/lines/0/subtotal200200
只改 discountEnabled，未命中 watch
input
引用位置之前之后
/cart/discountEnabledtruefalse
/cart/discount2525
/cart/payable225225
Host 报价返回 unitPrice=120，显式 Command 回填
Host 请求/响应（测试输入）
  ↓

07 · FORM ENGINE

出行日期、生日与地区规则

出行日期与生日送入领域纯函数，按合成地区规则生成资格结论；Constraint 归属到当前旅客的生日字段，不自动修改生日。

结构关系

树表示定义与引用，不按 Fixture 展开实际组件实例。

Data : object
├─ trip : object
│  ├─ startDate : string
│  └─ endDate : string
└─ travellers : array
   └─ [] : #/$defs/Traveller
views.default
Material stack
└─ slots.default
   ├─ Material date-range
   │  ├─ bindings.start ↔ data:/trip/startDate
   │  └─ bindings.end ↔ data:/trip/endDate
   ├─ Scope each traveller ← data:/travellers
   │  └─ $use traveller-fields
   │     └─ traveller ← traveller:〈根〉
   └─ Material button
      └─ on.activate → host.emit travel.submitRequested
viewTemplates.traveller-fields
Material section
└─ slots.default
   ├─ Material text-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ traveller:/name
   ├─ Material date-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ traveller:/birthDate
   ├─ Material select
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ traveller:/region
   ├─ Material text-input
   │  └─ bindings.value ↔ traveller:/passport
   └─ Material summary-card

变化流程

birthDate、trip.startDate、region 共同决定断言；改变出行日期或地区会重新检查同一生日，不产生修改生日的 Command。demo-A/B 是测试规则。

数据变化举证 · 2 个场景

来自有界抽测器的实际输出；步骤顺序不冻结正式 L3 调度算法。

出行日期提前至 2025-11-01；地区 B 年份差不足
Constraint 重新求值，未写生日
  ↓
Issue: age-on-departure
引用位置之前之后
/trip/startDate"2026-11-01""2025-11-01"
/travellers/1/birthDate"2008-12-01""2008-12-01"
第二位旅客 demo-B → demo-A；保持生日不变
纯年龄 Pure Function → Constraint Issue
引用位置之前之后
/travellers/1/region"demo-B""demo-A"
/travellers/1/birthDate"2008-12-01""2008-12-01"
08 · FORM ENGINE

命令、引用与事件环境

区分 Data、Context 与 Event 的读取位置；用 Command 表达修改，用 Literal 保留标记对象。数组位置尚未定稿的命令只展示已确认部分。

array.insert / array.move 的位置语法未固化；只展示确认字段，抽测器拒绝执行。

[
  {
    "status": "unverified",

    "meaning": "当前适用且必需义务尚无结论"
  },

    "meaning": "Host 正在执行验证"
  },
  {
    "status": "invalid",
    "ready": false,
    "meaning": "结果匹配当前依赖，但业务不通过；显示 Issues"
  },
  {
    "status": "error",
    "ready": false,
    "meaning": "验证执行失败；不能按通过处理"
  },
  {
    "status": "valid",
    "ready": "仍需 Schema、内部约束、其他必需义务和输出有效",
    "meaning": "不是收到一个 Valid 就允许真实提交"
  }
]
失效、乱序与 ABA
  1. 请求 A 关联 traveller 实例及依赖版本 v1
  2. 数据变化到 v2，A 的旧结论失效；发起请求 B
  3. B 返回当前有效 Valid，A 之后返回仍应丢弃，不能覆盖 B
  4. 同一业务值发生 ABA 也必须检查调用/依赖有效性；不能只比较 payload 值
  5. 非依赖字段变化不要求全量失效；真实结果接收与竞态测试留给 L3
编辑态、Field State 与输出
  1. 编辑态可暂时保存业务不合法值，解析失败与 false / null / Missing 分开
  2. Binding 经 Runtime Field State 让物料显示相应 Issues，不新增 validationBind / errorBind
  3. 校验与输出转换成功，构造 Normalized Output
  4. Host 根据 Readiness 和业务许可提交；HTTP 成功不是 L1 的状态字段
表达形式与 Profile 交付
  1. Authoring bind:/name → Canonical bindings.value:{source:data,path:/name}
  2. Authoring children:[...] → Canonical slots.default:[...]；不允许重复提供同一 Slot
  3. 选中 compact Profile，只交付入口及其静态 Template 依赖
  4. 保留共享 data / constraints / reactions 及所需命名表达式，不能按可见字段裁剪业务规则
  5. Prepared 是 L2 内部结构，不混入 Canonical
Host Services 边界
  1. country-picker / city-picker 的远程选项由 Material Adapter 注入的 Host Services 获取
  2. file-upload 由 Host 执行上传、重试等；完成后经受控 Command 写回业务引用
  3. 不在 Definition 里声明 URL、Promise、通用 Resource 或 Action 管道
